reason: The beard flight works, but the head is a bird of prey: a hooked raptor beak and eagle face make it read as an eagle, not the pheasant-shaped bird of the sources [wd-q17065939-c01, c06]. Keep the composition and the spreading throat-beard [c03, c06, c07]; give it a pheasant's small head and short, stout gamebird bill, pheasant body proportions and the barred long tail, with the paired wings visibly folded so the beard alone carries it.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Danghu, the pheasant-shaped bird that flies by the hair beneath its throat.
ANATOMY: one pheasant-shaped bird, one head, two eyes, one beak, two folded wings, two bird legs and one pheasant tail; long conspicuous beardlike feathers under throat, no horns or extra wings [wd-q17065939-c01, wd-q17065939-c06]
MOMENT: fly directly over the viewer with wings completely folded against body, lift generated visually by beard feathers spreading widely and sweeping the air under its throat
POWER: flight through long beardlike throat feathers rather than wingbeats; no magical glow, trails or beams [wd-q17065939-c03, wd-q17065939-c06, wd-q17065939-c07]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle; very close foreshortened bird fills square; ordinary bird size and distant mountain below
LIGHT & WEATHER: one warm sunset source, rim light through beard feathers, fine mountain mist
SURFACE: coarse layered pheasant feathers, fibrous flowing throat beard, dark walnut and antique gold plumage chosen editorially
SETTING: air above Mount Shangshen [wd-q17065939-c02]
MOOD: menacing / awe-inspiring; dangerous and imposing, never cute, calm or decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no design borrowed from any film, game, anime or comic; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons; no tattoos, glyphs or pseudo-text.

Flies using beard hair under throat, rather than wings.
